name: PlayStation VR2

desc.en: The PSVR2 takes VR gaming to the next level for PS5 owners: native eye tracking, haptic feedback in the headset, and adaptive triggers for unmatched immersion. Note: requires PS5 — not standalone, not PC-compatible.
desc.es: El PSVR2 lleva el gaming VR a otro nivel para dueños de PS5: eye tracking nativo, feedback háptico y gatillos adaptativos para una inmersión sin igual. Requiere PS5 — no es standalone ni compatible con PC.

schema_description: Premium VR headset for PS5 owners with native eye tracking, haptic feedback, and adaptive triggers. Requires PlayStation 5.
